maya: quick one 1 i've been thinking about making client-visible error signals canonical across API + console. put a short sketch below, want ops+ux sanity check before RFC.

devon: love it. is this additive or are we reshaping meaning for 429/503?

maya: additive semantics only. keep status codes, but add three small headers so clients + console can deterministically badge and show retry guidance: `x-rw-reason`, `x-rw-retryable`, `x-rw-retry-hint`.

sai: i'm worried about header proliferation. can we compress into `x-rw-signal` with comma-separated key=val?

lex: parsers and our alert rules assume flat headers. compressed blobs would require new parsing infra. small flat headers are cheaper.

sofia: console needs exact buckets: OK / THROTTLED / DEGRADED / UNAVAILABLE. we also need 1-line copy for each bucket (<=80 chars).

maya: proposed badge resolution (very short):
- 429 + reason=quota -> THROTTLED, retryable=true, retry-hint=Retry-After or secs
- 503 + reason=backpressure -> DEGRADED, retryable=false
- 424 + reason=downstream -> UNAVAILABLE, retryable=false, retry-hint="contact support"
- 5xx generic -> UNAVAILABLE, retryable=false, retry-hint="try later"

rui: note: don't advertise retry hints for non-idempotent endpoints. `x-rw-retryable` must be explicit true|false. log it as a metric tag.

devon: sdk compatibility note: surface headers in SDKs behind feature flag first. we'll need docs + sample handling.

lex: infra request: emit resolved badge as a traced tag and also keep raw headers in logs for samples. add a short-window backpressure metric so we can distinguish bursts from quota.

sofia: copy drafts:
- THROTTLED: "Rate limit reached 1 requests paused. Retry after {n}s or request more quota."
- DEGRADED: "Service degraded 1 responses may be slow. Avoid automatic retries."
- UNAVAILABLE: "Service unavailable 1 try again later or contact support."

maya: rollout plan: internal canary -> telemetry tag `client_surface_bucket` -> 2-week canary -> GA. also run a small reclassification job over S3 logs to backfill `client_surface_bucket` so dashboards don't jump.

ops-bot: preview deploy created for branch `error-surface/headers` 1 preview: https://deploys.internal/redwood/preview/2101

rui: add migration step in RFC + a small script to reclassify last 90 days. keep it cheap.

devon: i'll add SDK shims and a note about non-idempotent endpoints.

maya: I'll update RFC: final header names, badge mapping, telemetry tags, migration plan, canary window. ping when ready for sign-off.

sofia: tagging ux owners: @sofia will prep final copy and 2 variants for A/B.

ops-bot: scheduled canary rollout 2024-11-04T04:00Z on `canary-2` (50% traffic).
